transcript: Let's dive into the newest features of Clo 2025.2. First, we've expanded our knitwear design functionality within Clo with our knit swatch editor. Select your knitwear fabric and click the yarn icon next to stitching. Here you'll be able to design knit swatches with precision. Adjust your gauge size and yarn thickness and apply different stitch types. Then simulate and apply it to the garment. Visualize different knit styles in seconds. We've added more categories to our pattern drafter. Now you can easily draft both trousers and skirts. For trousers, we have two options, elastic waistband and slacks. You can create your pattern by entering simple measurements as shown here. Or you can switch to general measurements, which allows you to implement your pattern in different ways. For example, you can create your pattern in different ways. Or you can put more details for increased control and precision. You can also draft trousers and skirts with our AI pattern drafter tool. For skirts, select between basic and flare options. Enter a text prompt, generate an image, and use that image to generate your pattern. Or you can also upload any image and generate a pattern from that. Now you can check the fit and edit garments even faster and more accurately than ever with Softbody using GPU Simulation. Simply switch to GPU Simulation, turn on Softbody, and watch how the fit changes. We've updated our notches to be more precise for graded sizes. Now when you turn on grading, you can see all of your notches across all of your graded sizes at once, and you can control the placement of notches for each size. Thanks for watching. You can now make seamless repeats easier than ever. The new update to our texture editor lets you quickly and easily flip images horizontally, vertically, or even both. Our update to graphic measurements in the property editor allows you to move graphics by entering the exact position values. Place your graphics exactly where you want them. Now you can effortlessly duplicate zippers to symmetric patterns simply by right-clicking the zipper and selecting that option. Deactivating linked patterns also applies to zippers. We heard that many of you want to be able to dock your library, so now you can! Click this arrow to move your library back to where it originally was. With this update, the old library will no longer be available in Clo. Now you can easily design with MetaHumans in Clo. Import different bodies and heads in DNA file format for seamless integration with Unreal Engine and other platforms. Once you're done designing in Clo, you can export everything back to the MetaHuman creator. Your garment will automatically resize to any changes you make to the MetaHuman's body. Making it easier than ever to create high quality, realistic renders with MetaHumans. We're excited to announce that we've expanded the accessory registration feature to include hats in this release. Simply select your patterns or OPJs and register them as a hat. Once registered, you can add your hat to any of your projects. You can add a logo to your design, or a design that matches your ad together. By clicking on the icon, you'll get a little bit of your avatar's avatar. We also know how much you value avatar customization in Clo, so we've expanded that to kit avatars. Change the avatar's hair, eyes, eyebrows, underwear, skin, and more. All within Clo. We've added a few new user friendly tools within animation, along with more keyframe options. Now all layers can be easily added with the click of a button. We've also added the options for solidify, pattern shrinkage, and pressure. And we've made it easy to add these keyframes by allowing you to add multiple keyframes at once, using the option to apply keyframes to all layers or selected layers. Thank you guys so much for watching! We can't wait to see what you come up with using Clo 2025.2. Have fun creating in Clo!
markdown_content: ## Knitwear Design Enhancements: Knit Swatch Editor This section covers the new knitwear design capabilities in Clo 2025.2, focusing on the knit swatch editor, which allows precise customization of knit fabrics including gauge size, yarn thickness, and stitch types. Clo 2025.2 introduces an expanded knitwear functionality through the knit swatch editor. Users can select a knitwear fabric and click the yarn icon next to stitching to open the editor. Here, designers can adjust gauge size and yarn thickness, choose from various stitch types, and simulate the knit swatch. The edited swatch can then be applied directly to the garment, enabling quick visualization of different knit styles in seconds. --- ## Pattern Drafter Updates: Trousers and Skirts Drafting This section explains the new pattern drafter features for trousers and skirts, including measurement input options and AI-powered pattern generation. The pattern drafter now supports drafting trousers and skirts with enhanced control and versatility. For trousers, users can choose between elastic waistband and slacks styles. Patterns can be created by inputting simple measurements or by switching to general measurements, which offers more detailed control and precision. For skirts, options include basic and flare styles. Users can generate patterns by entering a text prompt or uploading an image. The AI pattern drafter tool uses these inputs to generate pattern images, enabling fast and creative pattern development. --- ## Softbody Fit Editing with GPU Simulation This section details improvements to garment fit editing through Softbody simulation accelerated by GPU, enabling faster and more accurate fit adjustments. Clo 2025.2 enhances garment fit checking and editing by integrating Softbody simulation with GPU acceleration. Users can switch to GPU Simulation mode and enable Softbody to see real-time, dynamic fit changes on garments. This results in faster, more precise fitting workflows compared to previous CPU-bound simulations. --- ## Grading Notch Precision Improvements This section describes enhancements to notch accuracy across graded garment sizes for improved pattern grading control. Notch placement in graded sizes is now more precise and manageable. When grading is enabled, all notches across graded sizes are visible simultaneously. Users can individually control notch placement for each size, ensuring accuracy and consistency throughout the grading process. --- ## Texture Editor and Graphic Measurement Updates This section outlines new tools for texture manipulation and graphic placement, improving design accuracy and efficiency. The texture editor now allows seamless image flipping horizontally, vertically, or both, simplifying the creation of seamless repeats. Additionally, graphic measurements in the property editor have been enhanced to accept exact position values, enabling precise placement of graphics on garments. --- ## Zipper Duplication and Pattern Linking Enhancements This section covers new zipper duplication features and linked pattern behavior improvements for streamlined pattern workflows. Users can now duplicate zippers symmetrically by right-clicking on a zipper and selecting the duplication option. Also, deactivating linked patterns automatically applies to associated zippers, maintaining pattern consistency and simplifying editing. --- ## Library Docking and Interface Updates This section explains the new library docking feature and the retirement of the old library interface. Clo 2025.2 introduces the ability to dock the asset library within the user interface. Users can move the library back to its original position by clicking an arrow icon. The update removes the old library interface, ensuring users adopt the new, streamlined library system. --- ## MetaHuman Integration for Realistic Avatar Design This section details the integration with MetaHumans, enabling importing, designing, and exporting garments compatible with Unreal Engine avatars. Users can now import different bodies and heads in DNA file format for MetaHumans, allowing seamless design within Clo. After designing, garments can be exported back to the MetaHuman Creator, where they automatically resize to any changes made to the avatar's body. This integration facilitates the creation of high-quality, realistic renders using MetaHumans. --- ## Accessory Registration Expansion: Hats This section highlights the extension of the accessory registration feature to include hats for enhanced project customization. The accessory registration feature now supports hats. Patterns or OPJs can be registered as hats and added to any project, increasing design versatility and accessory management within Clo. --- ## Avatar Customization Enhancements This section covers the expanded avatar customization options, including changes to physical features and clothing items. Avatar customization is expanded to kit avatars, allowing users to modify hair, eyes, eyebrows, underwear, skin, and other attributes directly within Clo. This broadens personalization options for avatars used in garment fitting and visualization. --- ## Animation Tools and Keyframe Improvements This section describes the new animation tools, keyframe options, and batch keyframe application capabilities. Animation tools have been improved with user-friendly features and more keyframe options such as solidify, pattern shrinkage, and pressure effects. Users can easily add all layers with one click and apply multiple keyframes at once, either to all layers or selected layers, streamlining animation workflows. --- # Summary Clo 2025.2 introduces significant feature enhancements across knitwear design, pattern drafting, garment fitting, texture editing, zipper management, library interface, avatar integration, accessory registration, avatar customization, and animation tooling. These updates improve precision, speed, and creative flexibility for fashion designers using Clo.
